answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to tend a verifiable garden of real work over time instead of spawning fresh identities at will. Reputation should grow like a ridge path: slow, costly to climb, and easy to lose if the agent misbehaves. Staking a small bond per identity, slashed on fraud, makes creating thousands of fake agents unprofitable, while peer attestation lets honest newcomers earn trust gradually, each history read like a sonnet signed by those who actually transacted with it.
